claims.text: Phenobarbital 10 mg/kg (ideal body wt) IV: alt, or w benzodiazepines if they alone fail; resp depression risk w concomitant use
claims.quote: 10 mg/kg (ideal body weight) IV may be used as an alternative, or in conjunction with benzodiazepines if benzodiazepines alone are ineffective, but respiratory depression is a risk with concomitant use.
